designReview.evidence: The independent 2026-09-28 review rates D01-02 at 78/80; its course-by-course Q16 entry and §17 generation boundary are included in the shared review report.

criteria.evidence: 02-monster-organizer.md §4 defines two state-changing AI-directed fit/retrieval workflows; §17 retains I1/I2 in local deterministic scope.
Section 4 identifies blocked interior capacity and removal-path failure, then specifies targeted feedback and same-condition retry.
Sections 3 and 7 transfer the fit/retrieval test to changed prop placement and require a learner-chosen tradeoff.
Sections 3-4 diagnose external dimensions being mistaken for usable capacity and require actual insertion/removal evidence.
Section 4 feedback points to the observed collision or blocked opening and gives a single-variable retry.
Sections 7 and 10 require the editable organizer, props, insertion/removal views and a documented design tradeoff.
